lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration posterior to the branchial region along the lateral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal spot rows, creating a primary grid structure on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, marked by a high-contrast transition between light-exposed upper pixels and shadowed lower pixels.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance circular blobs localized within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated near the base and leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular indentation or notch on the posterior trailing margin of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) clustered around the ventral-lateral region near the pectoral fin and branchial slits.
